description: This file implements network statistics collection, reporting, and management functions for Zephyr OS, including periodic output, interface-specific stats, and user API handlers.

methods.name: priority2str
methods.description: Converts a net_priority enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: cmp_val
methods.description: Compares two uint64_t values and returns their difference as int64_t.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Prints network interface or global statistics periodically.

methods.name: net_print_statistics_iface
methods.description: Prints statistics for a specific network interface.

methods.name: iface_cb
methods.description: Callback function for iterating over network interfaces to print stats.

methods.name: net_print_statistics_all
methods.description: Prints statistics for all network interfaces.

methods.name: net_stats_get
methods.description: Handles retrieval of various network statistics via user API.

methods.name: net_stats_reset
methods.description: Resets network statistics for a specific interface or all.
